college_placement_real.csv.title: Engineering College Placement Dataset
college_placement_real.csv.description: 2,966 engineering student records across 6 engineering streams (CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, ME, Civil) with CGPA, internships, backlogs, and placement outcomes.

campus_recruitment_real.csv.title: Campus Recruitment Academic & Placement Dataset
campus_recruitment_real.csv.description: 215 undergraduate and postgraduate students with secondary (10th), higher secondary (12th), degree percentages, employability test marks, and placement status.

uci_student_performance_real.csv.title: UCI Student Academic Performance Dataset (Cortez & Silva, 2008)
uci_student_performance_real.csv.description: 395 secondary school student records evaluating socio-demographics, parental education, study time, alcohol consumption, absences, and longitudinal exam marks (G1, G2, G3).
